denied.body: Your role lacks the right to read sales and bank lines. An admin can grant it under Members.

notReady.one: {count} line is not proven by a reference, was changed or waits on the agent, and stays.
notReady.other: {count} lines are not proven by a reference, were changed or wait on the agent, and stay.

first.noStatementHint: After the import every line appears here, with a proposal to book it.

empty.openHint: New lines appear here when you import the next statement.
empty.bookedHint: Booked and matched lines appear here, with a reversal.
empty.ignoredHint: Ignored lines appear here and can be brought back.
empty.filteredTitle: No line matches the search and filter.
empty.filteredHint: Reset the search and filter to see every line.

search.label: Search
search.labelLong: Search name, text, reference or amount

row.needsPost: You lack the right to post.
row.needsPay: Settling an invoice or a payment run needs the right to book payments.
row.ignoreTip: Do not book, with a reason
row.vatSummaryTip: VAT per position in the details

picker.search: Search an account, invoice or amount
picker.actDenied: you lack the right to post

reason.existing_entry_reference: The books already hold an entry of {date} with the same reference: {description}. Matching links both; no new entry is made.

existing_entry_amount_date.one: The books hold an entry of {date} for the same amount, without a bank line yet ({days} day apart). No reference proves it; it could be a second payment.
existing_entry_amount_date.other: The books hold an entry of {date} for the same amount, without a bank line yet ({days} days apart). No reference proves it; it could be a second payment.

reason.existing_entry_same_day: The books hold an entry of the same day ({date}) for the same amount, without a bank line yet. No reference proves it; it could be a second payment.
reason.qr_reference_exact: The QR reference belongs to the open invoice {number} of {contact}, and the amount matches to the cent.
reason.qr_reference_amount_differs: The QR reference belongs to invoice {number} of {contact}, but the amount differs by {delta}.
reason.payment_batch_reference: TILL created this payment run. The bank reports the same reference and the same amount, {total}.
reason.payment_batch_total_differs: The bank reports the reference of a payment run, but the amount differs: run {batch}, bank {line}. The line cannot be matched to the run this way. Discard the run under Creditor payments, record the executed payments by hand under Payments, and ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere".
reason.vendor_bill_reference: The reference belongs to the open supplier bill {number} of {vendor}.
reason.vendor_bill_amount: An open supplier bill has the same amount: {number} of {vendor}. No reference proves it.
reason.own_account_transfer: The counterparty is your own account "{name}". This is a transfer, not an expense.

own_account_transfer_booked.one: The transfer from "{name}" is already on the books, booked on {date} ({days} day apart). Match it instead of booking it twice.
own_account_transfer_booked.other: The transfer from "{name}" is already on the books, booked on {date} ({days} days apart). Match it instead of booking it twice.

reason.own_account_transfer_booked_same_day: The transfer from "{name}" is already on the books, booked the same day ({date}). Match it instead of booking it twice.
reason.history: On {date} you last booked this counterparty to {account}, {vat} ({count} times like this).
reason.no_proposal: No reference and no earlier booking fit.
reason.payment_batch_item: The bank reports one payment of a payment run, named by its reference: {amount}.
reason.payment_batch_item_amount_differs: The reference names one payment of a payment run, but the amount differs: payment {item}, bank {line}. The line cannot be matched to the run this way. Discard the run under Creditor payments, record the executed payments by hand under Payments, and ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere".
reason.payment_batch_total_differs_paid: The bank reports the reference of a payment run, but the amount differs: run {batch}, bank {line}. The run is already marked paid and can no longer be discarded: ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere" and reverse under Payments every payment of the run the bank did not carry out.
reason.payment_batch_item_amount_differs_paid: The reference names one payment of a payment run, but the amount differs: payment {item}, bank {line}. The run is already marked paid and can no longer be discarded: ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere" and reverse under Payments every payment of the run the bank did not carry out.
reason.own_account_transfer_booked_other_month: The transfer from "{name}" is booked there on {date}, in another month than this line. It cannot be matched that way: take the other side back and book each side on its own day through a transit account you add to the chart.
reason.model_suggested: An AI model on this device suggests {account}, {percent} % likely ({count} accounts to choose from). Nobody has checked it yet: look before you book.
reason.standard: Your booking rule for this counterparty: {account}, {vat}.
reason.standardVatDropped: Your booking rule for this counterparty: {account}, here without {vat}. The line is in {currency}, and no VAT can be booked on a line in a foreign currency. Check that you want to book it gross like this.
reason.journal_history: Booked like this in the journal on {date}: {account}, {vat}.
reason.rule_needs_amount: Your booking rule "{name}" fits. Enter {asks}, TILL works out the rest.
reason.several_rules: {count} booking rules fit this counterparty, and the text does not decide. Pick one or book it another way.
reason.rule_ignore: Your booking rule "{name}" says: do not book ({reason}). The line never reaches the books, so you decide it yourself.
reason.rule_computed: Buchungsregel «{name}» computes {asks}. Check the figure, then book.

panel.linkMissing: This bank line is not in this book.
panel.label: Bank line details
panel.howPlatform: VAT {vat} % and a fee of {fee} % of the net
panel.howFee: a fee of {fee} % of the net

legs.title: This is what posts
legs.pickFirst: Choose what to book to first.
legs.noRight: The preview needs the right to read the books and the VAT.

item.paidInFull: {item} is paid in full with this.
item.shortWriteOff: Part payment: the rest of {rest} is written off, {item} is then settled.
item.surplusCredit: Overpayment: {rest} stays as the customer's credit, {item} is paid in full.
item.surplusDebit: Paid more than owed: {rest} stays as a credit with the supplier, {item} is paid in full.
item.unknownOpen: The open amount of {item} could not be read. TILL works it out when booking.

batch.title: Payment run

markPaid.one: The bank carried out the payment run of {date}. Booking marks it paid: one supplier bill then counts as paid.
markPaid.other: The bank carried out the payment run of {date}. Booking marks it paid: {count} supplier bills then count as paid.

alreadyPaid.one: This payment run of {date} is already marked paid. The line is linked to its payment without a new entry.
alreadyPaid.other: This payment run of {date} is already marked paid. The line is linked to its {count} payments without a new entry.

batch.totalDiffers: The payment run is for {batch}, the bank for {line}.

compare.title: Bank and books
compare.differenceReason: Why does the amount differ by {amount}?
compare.readFailed: The entry could not be read.

split.title: Split or book manually
split.accountMissing: Amount distributed, an account is missing
split.viaHint: The bank books against this account, every position away from it. It nets to zero.
split.viaTip: The line runs through an account that ends at zero

link.title: Match an existing entry
link.lead: Already booked, for example by hand or as the payment of an invoice? Choose the entry this line belongs to. No new entry is made.
link.readFailed: The entries on the bank account could not be read.
link.none: No entry on the bank account fits within 30 days of the line. Book the line new.
link.taken: already belongs to a bank line
link.difference: The amounts differ by {amount}. TILL records the difference with the match.
link.consequence: Matching links the line to this entry. The entry stays unchanged and counts once.

ignore.title: Ignore the line
ignore.private: Paid privately? Then do not ignore it; book it to {account}.
ignore.note: A note for you or the accountant
ignore.noteRequired: The reason in your own words
ignore.consequence: The line leaves the list but stays in the bank balance. If its money reaches the books nowhere, the check above shows it as a difference.

booked_elsewhere.label: Booked elsewhere
booked_elsewhere.hint: for example by the accountant or through another account

clearing_account.label: Runs through a clearing account
clearing_account.hint: for example card turnover booked in total

before_start.label: Before the start in TILL
before_start.hint: lies before the first posting date of these books

duplicate.label: Delivered twice
duplicate.hint: the same movement already stands as another line

other.label: Other reason
other.hint: with a note in your own words

reopen.title: Reverse
reopen.noteRequired: The reason in your own words
reopen.consequenceBooked: Reversing posts a counter-entry; the original entry stays in the journal. The line is then to book again.
reopen.consequenceSettlement: Reversing reverses the payment and reopens the invoice. The line is then to book again.
reopen.consequenceMatched: The existing entry stays unchanged; only the link to the line is undone. The line is then to book again.
reopen.consequenceIgnored: The line returns to the list and nothing is posted. The earlier decision stays on record with your reason.
reopen.consequenceBatch: The payment run's payments stay booked; only the link to the line is undone. The line is then to book again.

decided.matched: with an entry already on the books
decided.noEntry: This line has no entry of its own.

warning.control_account_leg_before: You book straight to {account}, with no invoice behind it. Settle an open invoice by picking it as the target.
warning.control_account_leg: Booked to a control account (receivables or payables), with no invoice behind it.
warning.accepted_difference: The difference is recorded with your reason and shows in the balance.
warning.reversal_line: The line is a reversal by the bank.
warning.batch_payments_kept: The payment run's payments stay booked. Reverse one of them under Payments.
warning.not_day_end_statement: This is not a day-end statement: it has no sequence number or no closing balance. Import the day-end camt.053 for this day as well.
warning.statement_number_jump: The statement number jumps: numbers are missing between the last statement in the books and this one. Import those statements by hand if they exist.
warning.possible_cross_format_duplicate: A new line resembles a line from another file format. TILL imported it and marked it: check it in the bank inbox and ignore it as a duplicate if it is one.
warning.overlap_same_movement: New lines match movements already in the books. TILL imported and marked them: decide line by line, or all exact matches at once.
warning.covered_period_new_line: New lines fall on days a statement already covers. TILL marked them: check whether they are new.

vorschlag.own: You made this proposal yourself. A second person approves it.
vorschlag.noRight: You lack the right to manage the agent, which approving needs.

trust.label: Reconciliation {name}

unknown.no_statement: Cannot be judged: no statement yet.
unknown.no_balance: Cannot be judged: the statement has no closing balance.
unknown.currency_differs: Cannot be judged: the statement is in another currency than the account.
unknown.inconsistent: Cannot be judged: the figures do not add up.

trust.differenceHint: Possible cause: an ignored line, an entry without a bank line, or an accepted difference.
trust.startGap: Movements before {date} are missing (the bank starts at {bank}): import earlier statements.

summary.label: Reconciliation of all bank accounts
summary.cardLabel: Reconciliation of all bank accounts: by account

import.title: Import bank statement
import.lead: Load the camt.053 file from your e-banking. TILL reads the account from the file.
import.hint: camt.053, as XML, one or more files
import.notXml: That is not an XML file. Download the statement from your e-banking as camt.053.
import.leadAny: Load the statement from your e-banking: camt.053 (XML), MT940 or CSV. TILL reads the account from a camt or MT940 file.
import.notStatement: That is not a statement file. Download it from your e-banking as camt.053, MT940 or CSV.
import.oneAtATime: An MT940 or CSV file is imported one at a time: TILL takes "{name}".

csv.title: Assign the columns
csv.lead: Pick the column of your file for each item. TILL saves the assignment for this bank account and uses it next time.
csv.pickAccount: Choose the bank account first, so TILL can find its saved assignment.
csv.saved: The saved assignment of this bank account is selected.
csv.guessed: TILL suggested the columns from their headings. Check them.
csv.amountRule: Either one amount column with a sign, or a debit and a credit column.
csv.preview: The first rows of the file

missing.bookingDate: The column for the booking date is missing.
missing.amount: The column for the amount (or for debit and credit) is missing.

csv.unknown: The file has no column "{column}". Pick another one.

result.counts: New: {imported} · Already in the books: {duplicates} · Not read: {refused}

skip.cross_format_duplicate: already in the books from another file format
skip.currency_differs: another currency than the bank account
skip.not_a_movement: no booking (a total or a note)

warning.account_unverified: The account in the file is not an IBAN: check that it is the right bank account.
warning.possible_cross_format_duplicate: A new line resembles a line from another file format. Check it in the bank inbox.
warning.overlap_same_movement: Some lines are already in the books from another delivery of the same days. They wait in the bank inbox: answer Duplikat or Kein Duplikat.
warning.covered_period_new_line: Some lines fall on days the books already hold a statement for and match nothing there. Check them in the bank inbox.
warning.not_day_end_statement: The file is not a day-end statement: import that day's day-end statement too.

refused.account_mismatch: the file belongs to another account
refused.currency_mismatch: the file is in another currency than the bank account
refused.statement_amended: the bank changed this statement since it was imported

refusal.bankFeed: This bank account is fed over EBICS. Import camt.053 only here; TILL does not take MT940 or CSV for this account.
refusal.mapping: The column assignment does not fit the file.
refusal.severalAccounts: The file holds statements of several accounts ({accounts}), and none of them is recognisably this bank account. Import each account's statements onto its own bank account.

ack.matched: Matched: {party} with the entry of {date}, no new entry.
ack.matchedAny: Matched: {party} with the entry already on the books, no new entry.

pickedRefused.one: One line stayed; the reason is on the line.
pickedRefused.other: {count} lines stayed; the reason is on the line.

bulkRefused.one: One line could not be booked; the reason is on the line.
bulkRefused.other: {count} lines could not be booked; the reason is on the line.

ack.ignored: {party} ignored. The line stays in the bank balance.
ack.reopened: Reversed: {party} is back to booking. The original entry stays in the journal.
ack.unmatched: Unmatched: {party} is back to booking; the entry stays unchanged.

imported.one: Statement imported: one new line on "{name}".

ack.importedNothing: Statement read: no new lines on "{name}".
ack.importDuplicate: This statement is already imported. Nothing was recorded twice.

importSkipped.one: One booking not taken over because it was already there or not booked yet.
importSkipped.other: {count} bookings not taken over because they were already there or not booked yet.

importedFilesRefused.one: One statement was not imported; the reason was shown in the window.
importedFilesRefused.other: {count} statements were not imported; the reasons were shown in the window.

ack.selfBookedOpen: The agent's proposal is still open: reject it under Attention.
ack.vorschlagLeftOpen: The agent's proposal stays open: someone allowed to decide proposals can close it.

agent.question: How do I book this bank line: {date}, {party}, {amount}?

error.fallbackTitle: That could not be carried out.
error.toAccounts: Go to the chart of accounts

action.acceptDifference: Match anyway and record the difference
action.leaveOpen: Leave the rest open and book

periodLocked.title: The period {period} is locked.
periodLocked.body: Nothing is booked there, not even on another date. Reopen the month under Periods, then try again.

periodSealed.title: The period {period} is sealed (VAT filed or year closed).
periodSealed.body: Nothing more is booked there. Ignore the line as "Booked elsewhere"; if the money is not in the books yet, book the movement by hand in the open period. A wrong booking is corrected by a reclassification entry in the open period.

lineNotOpen.title: This line is already decided.
lineNotOpen.body: Someone decided it in the meantime: {state}. Reload the list to see where it stands.

batchAmountMismatch.title: The amount does not fit the payment run.
batchAmountMismatch.body: The bank reports {line}, the payment run is for {batch}, and no single payment of the run is named by its reference. Discard the run under Creditor payments, record the executed payments by hand under Payments, and ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere".

entryAmountMismatch.title: The entry has a different amount.
entryAmountMismatch.body: Bank {line}, entry {entry}. If it still belongs to this line, write under the comparison why the amount differs and match it: TILL records the difference and the reason.

directionMismatch.title: The entry runs the other way.
directionMismatch.body: The line is {line}; the entry moves the bank account by {entry}. Pick another entry or book the line anew.

writeOffAboveThreshold.title: The remainder of {rest} is too large to write off.
writeOffAboveThreshold.body: One click writes off up to {threshold}. Leave the rest open and dun or book it later.

differenceReasonMissing.title: Say why the amount differs.
differenceReasonMissing.body: Matching with a difference records your reason. Write it in the field under the comparison.

entryAlreadyLinked.title: This entry already belongs to another bank line.
entryAlreadyLinked.body: An entry counts for one bank line only. Choose another entry or book the line new.

batchAlreadyLinked.title: This payment run already belongs to another bank line.
batchAlreadyLinked.body: A payment run counts for one bank line only. Check the other line.

entryNotOnBank.title: The entry does not touch this bank account.
entryNotOnBank.body: Choose an entry that posts to this bank's account.

entryIsReversal.title: That is a reversing entry.
entryIsReversal.body: A reversing entry cannot be matched to a bank line. Choose the entry itself.

entryReversed.title: This entry is reversed.
entryReversed.body: Choose a valid entry or book the line new.

legsDoNotSum.title: The positions do not add up to the line.
legsDoNotSum.body: The line is for {expected}, the positions for {sum}. Distribute the whole amount.

vatSplitMismatch.title: The VAT split does not add up.
vatSplitMismatch.body: Check the VAT codes of the positions and book the rest without VAT.

currencyMismatch.title: The currencies do not fit.
currencyMismatch.body: The line is in {line}, the invoice or account in {other}. Choose an invoice in {line}.

wrongDirectionIn.title: Money is coming in.
wrongDirectionIn.body: Incoming money settles a customer invoice, not a supplier bill. Choose an open invoice or an account.

wrongDirectionOut.title: Money is going out.
wrongDirectionOut.body: Outgoing money settles a supplier bill, not a customer invoice. Choose a supplier bill or an account.

alreadyPaid.title: The invoice is already paid.
alreadyPaid.body: Choose another invoice or book the line to an account. Reload the list to see the open invoices.

notSettleable.title: This supplier bill is not posted yet.
notSettleable.body: It is {status}. Post it under supplier bills first.

wrongBankAccount.title: The payment run belongs to another bank account.
wrongBankAccount.body: Match it with the line on its own account.

needsGeneration.title: The payment run is still a draft.
needsGeneration.body: Generate the payment file first; then it can be matched with the bank.

batchDiscarded.title: The payment run is discarded.
batchDiscarded.body: Book the line to the individual supplier bills.

batchPaymentsNotPosted.title: A payment of the run is missing.
batchPaymentsNotPosted.body: A payment was reversed or never posted. Book the rest by hand under Payments.

accountArchived.title: The account is archived.
accountArchived.body: Choose an active account, or restore the account in the chart.

taxCodeInactive.title: The VAT code {code} is no longer active.
taxCodeInactive.body: Choose an active code, or reactivate it in the VAT settings.

rateEraUnknown.title: TILL knows no VAT rate for this date.
rateEraUnknown.body: Book the line without VAT, or record the entry in the journal and then match the line.

vatLinesRefused.title: The VAT entry could not be built.
vatLinesRefused.body: Check that the VAT accounts 1170 and 2200 are in the chart, and try again.

vatForeignCurrency.title: TILL does not book VAT on a foreign-currency line here.
vatForeignCurrency.body: Book the line without VAT, or enter the booking in the journal and match it.

writeOffOnlyInvoices.title: Writing off works on customer invoices only.
writeOffOnlyInvoices.body: On a supplier bill the rest stays open.

writeOffAccount.title: Write-offs always go to the bad-debt account.
writeOffAccount.body: Leave the account empty; TILL chooses it.

ibanUnregistered.title: The account {iban} is not registered yet.
ibanUnregistered.body: The file belongs to a bank account TILL does not know yet. Add it with the IBAN {iban}, then import the file again.

noBankAccount.title: The bank account is missing.
noBankAccount.body: Add the bank account first, then import its statements.

ibanMismatch.title: The file belongs to "{name}".
ibanMismatch.body: Its IBAN is {fileIban}; the chosen account "{chosen}" has {accountIban}. Import it to the right account.

bankAccountArchived.title: The bank account "{name}" is archived.
bankAccountArchived.body: An archived account takes no statements. Restore it under Bank accounts.

camt052.title: That is an intraday report (camt.052).
camt052.body: TILL reads the day-end statement camt.053. Download it from your e-banking.

notXml.title: The file is empty or not XML.
notXml.body: Download the statement again from your e-banking as camt.053.

multipleAccounts.title: The file holds several accounts.
multipleAccounts.body: Download one statement per account from your e-banking.

batchSum.title: A batch booking in the file does not add up.
batchSum.body: The single amounts do not add up to the batch total. Ask your bank for a corrected file.

batchAmount.title: A batch booking in the file has no readable amount.
batchAmount.body: Ask your bank for a corrected file.

noStatementId.title: The statement lacks its identifier.
noStatementId.body: Without it a double import cannot be recognised. Download the file again.

notStatement.title: The file is not a bank statement.
notStatement.body: TILL reads the statement camt.053. Download it from your e-banking in that format.

unreadable.title: The file could not be read.
unreadable.body: Download the statement again from your e-banking as camt.053.

statementAmended.title: The bank delivered this statement changed.
statementAmended.body: Changed: {changes}. TILL did not overwrite the existing statement. Check the lines and, if in doubt, ask your bank.

permissionDenied.title: You lack the right for that.
permissionDenied.body: An admin can grant it under Members.

cannotSelfApprove.title: A second person approves your own proposal.
cannotSelfApprove.body: Ask another person with the right to manage the agent.

notFound.title: That no longer exists.
notFound.body: Someone changed it in the meantime. Reload the list.

invalidInput.title: An entry is missing or does not fit.
invalidInput.body: Check the fields and try again. What you entered is still there.

transport.title: TILL could not be reached just now.
transport.body: Nothing is booked twice. Try again; what you entered is still there.

batchItemMismatch.title: The amount does not fit the payment in the run.
batchItemMismatch.body: The bank reports {line}, the payment in the run is for {item}. Discard the run under Creditor payments, record the executed payments by hand under Payments, and ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere".

batchCurrency.title: The payment run is in another currency.
batchCurrency.body: The line is in {line}, the run in {batch}. Mark the run paid under Creditor payments, ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere" and book the exchange difference by hand.

alreadyBatched.title: The supplier bill is in a payment run.
alreadyBatched.body: The run pays it. Match the line to the payment run, or discard the run first under Creditor payments.

transferAlreadyBooked.title: The other side of this transfer is already booked.
transferAlreadyBooked.body: The other bank account already booked the transfer. Match this line to that entry instead of booking it twice.

ownedByLine.title: This entry belongs to another bank line.
ownedByLine.body: Take that line back first, then this one. For a transfer between two of your own accounts, that means the other side first.

ownedByPayment.title: This entry belongs to a payment.

useBankInbox.title: You decide this credit under Bank.
useBankInbox.body: It comes from a bank statement and is booked on its bank line.

camt054.title: That is a credit notification (camt.054), not a statement.
camt054.body: TILL reads only the day-end statement camt.053. Download it from your e-banking and import it.

transferCrossesPeriod.title: The other side of this transfer is booked in another month.
transferCrossesPeriod.body: The other bank booked it on {entryDate}, this line is from {lineDate}. Take the other side back and book each side on its own day through a transit account, or that month's bank reconciliation can never close.

currencyMismatchAccount.title: The line is in another currency than the bank account.
currencyMismatchAccount.body: The line is in {line}, the bank account in {other}. TILL does not know the rate the bank applied: record the entry in the journal, then match the line.

needsFxRate.title: The {currency} rate of {date} is missing.
needsFxRate.body: Without a rate TILL converts and books nothing. Record the rate under Foreign currency, then book the line.

needsAccount.title: An account this booking needs is missing from the chart.
needsAccount.body: Add the account to the chart of accounts, then book the line.

counterpartyMerged.title: The counterparty was merged in the meantime.
counterpartyMerged.body: It now belongs to another contact. Reload the list and decide the line again.

vorschlagRejected.title: This proposal is already rejected.
vorschlagRejected.body: Someone rejected it in the meantime. Reload the list.

vorschlagExecuted.title: This proposal has already been carried out.
vorschlagExecuted.body: Someone approved it in the meantime. Reload the list to see where things stand.

batchAmountMismatchPaid.title: The amount does not fit the payment run.
batchAmountMismatchPaid.body: The bank reports {line}, the payment run is for {batch}. The run is already marked paid and can no longer be discarded: ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere" and reverse under Payments every payment of the run the bank did not carry out.

batchItemMismatchPaid.title: The amount does not fit the payment in the run.
batchItemMismatchPaid.body: The bank reports {line}, the payment in the run is for {item}. The run is already marked paid and can no longer be discarded: ignore this line as "Booked elsewhere" and reverse under Payments every payment of the run the bank did not carry out.

feedRule.body: This account runs over EBICS: TILL imports a statement only when it follows the statements in the books without a gap. Bank accounts shows which statement in the books is the newest.

vorschlagStale.title: Not run: this proposal is out of date.
vorschlagStale.body: The record behind it changed after the agent made it. Ask the agent to propose it again.

noCounterparty.title: This line names no counterparty.
noCounterparty.body: A booking rule applies per counterparty (IBAN or name). Book this line by hand.

invalidAccount.title: This account cannot carry a booking rule.
invalidAccount.body: A bank account, a control account (1100, 2000), a VAT account or an archived account does not work for a booking rule. Choose another account.

invalidTaxCode.title: This VAT code no longer exists.
invalidTaxCode.body: Choose an active code or no VAT, then save the booking rule.

vatNotApplicable.title: No VAT applies on this account.
vatNotApplicable.body: Choose no VAT or an income or expense account, then save the booking rule.

invalidRecipe.title: The booking rule cannot be saved like this.
invalidRecipe.body: A rule needs exactly one rest, a label for every amount it asks for, and accounts that can be booked to. A clearing account is a balance sheet account that no position uses.

ruleNotFound.title: This booking rule no longer exists.
ruleNotFound.body: Reload the lines and choose how to book this one.

ruleNotApplicable.title: This booking rule does not fit this line.
ruleNotApplicable.body: It applies to another counterparty or the other direction. Choose an account for this line.

askMissing.title: An amount is missing.
askMissing.body: Enter every amount the rule asks for, above zero.

invalidRecipeSame.title: The booking rule cannot be saved like this.
invalidRecipeSame.body: "Same amount as" always points at an asked amount, never at the rest and never at its own line.

invalidRecipeSide.title: The template cannot be saved like this.
invalidRecipeSide.body: Every line of a template is a debit or a credit. A rule for bank lines follows the direction of the line.

invalidRecipeIgnore.title: The booking rule cannot be saved like this.

Bank.title: Bank
Bank.body:
Every line of your bank statements is here, from every account. You decide each one on its own row: book it, settle an open invoice, match it to an existing entry, or ignore it with the ×. Click a line and the details beside it show what will be booked and where the proposal comes from. Above the list stands the difference between bank and books.

The ☆ saves a booking rule for the counterparty. A booking rule only proposes. Nothing is booked until you click. You can overwrite a computed amount. Attach a receipt with the paperclip or drop it on its line. TILL keeps it for ten years.

gapRepair.title: Close the gap
gapRepair.loadError: The gap could not be loaded. Close this window and try again.
gapRepair.notFound: This gap no longer exists: the statements are in the books now.
gapRepair.leadZkb: In ZKB e-banking, download the camt.053 statements for {dates} and drop them here. Overlapping days do no harm.
gapRepair.leadOther: In your bank's e-banking, download the camt.053 statements for {dates} and drop them here. Overlapping days do no harm.

zkb.3: Choose the format camt.053 and the account {account}.
zkb.4: Under the data scope choose «Alle erneut abholen», enter {dates} as the period and click «Abholen».

other.1: Open the statement download in e-banking, format camt.053.
other.2: Choose the account {account} and the period {dates}.
other.3: Download the files. If your bank asks whether to fetch statements already fetched again: yes.

gapRepair.warnZkb: Do not choose «Alle nicht abgeholten Daten». It marks the days as fetched at ZKB, and TILL's automatic fetch may no longer get them.
gapRepair.warnOther: Do not download the statements as «new, not yet fetched» data. The bank then counts them as fetched, and TILL's automatic fetch may no longer get them.
gapRepair.hint: One or more XML files, also one file holding several days.
gapRepair.notXml: That is not an XML file. Download the statements in the camt.053 format.
gapRepair.denied: Only someone who may manage payments can import statements and confirm gaps.
gapRepair.closed: The gap is closed: statements {range} are in the books.
gapRepair.confirmed: Confirmed: nothing is missing in the gap {range}.

refused.gap: It does not follow the statement before it: {amount} is missing in between. Download the days before it too.
refused.overlap: The books already hold another statement under this number.
refused.beforeFeedStart: It lies before the first statement in the books.
refused.notDayEnd: This is not a day-end statement (number or closing balance missing).
refused.multipage: The statement is split across several files. TILL does not read those yet.
refused.split: The file holds statements of several accounts, or without a number. Download the days one by one.
refused.otherAccount: The file belongs to another account.
refused.camt054: This is a camt.054, not a statement. Download camt.053.
refused.amended: The bank delivered this statement again with different content. Check it under Bank.
